_doc: Per-host list of sibling repo checkouts that share the cross-repo inbox channel. Copy to ops/moon_sync_repos.json (gitignored) and fill in the real paths. This repo is always polled and does not need listing. An absent file means the poller only watches this repo, which is the correct behaviour for a fresh clone.
_env_override: RC_MOON_SYNC_REPOS, os.pathsep-separated, wins over this file.
_participants_doc: participants maps a short COUNTERPARTY CODE to that sibling's checkout path, for the inbox responder (tools/inbox_responder_runner.py): the arming record ops/runtime/inbox_responder_agreement.json names counterparties by code, and a code absent from this map is refused. The poller reads participants too, to render every surface by CODE rather than by path: a root absent from this map renders as UNMAPPED and the status header says how many. An existing gitignored file that lacks the key still works - the poller only loses the codes. The real map lives in the gitignored ops/moon_sync_repos.json. Real sibling names and paths NEVER enter a tracked file - codes only, and the example path below is a placeholder.
_narrowed_names_doc: narrowed_names is read ONLY by the sibling-name sweep (tools/sibling_name_sweep.py). It lists checkout BASENAMES - not paths - whose BARE-WORD arm is suppressed. Declare a basename here when it is an ordinary dictionary word that occurs legitimately in this repo's own prose, where a bare-word match identifies nobody and only produces hundreds of false halts. A narrowed slot KEEPS its drive-path arm and its github-URL arm, in both the spaced and the tight view, and the config-free structural arm is unaffected - so every form that actually identifies a counterparty still halts the push. Four rules. (1) Narrowing is DECLARED per slot and never inferred; nothing inspects a name to guess whether it is generic. (2) An absent key, an empty list, or an entry matching no slot all mean FULL STRENGTH, so a typo fails closed. (3) It is not silent: the ARMED banner prints the narrowed count on every surface, including the pre-push hook and tools/sibling_sweep_ci.py. (4) The names below are PLACEHOLDERS. A real sibling basename belongs only in the gitignored ops/moon_sync_repos.json, because this repo is PUBLIC. The env-path equivalent is RC_MOON_SYNC_NARROWED_NAMES, semicolon- or colon-separated, since RC_MOON_SYNC_REPOS carries paths only and cannot express a declaration.
